variants.title: A · 悬弧
variants.caption: 轻盈悬弧，柔和上升
variants.prompt: Create ONE refined abstract product icon for GraviGo, a mobile companion to Antigravity. The attached image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: learn its soft flowing silhouette, generous white space, restrained smooth rainbow gradient, friendly simplicity, and feeling of weightless upward movement. Design an ORIGINAL new symbol, not the same glyph. No need for any letter, initials, text, code symbol or literal object. Simple memorable organic geometry, one coherent sculptural-looking but essentially FLAT gradient glyph with no surface reflections. Curves must feel optically drawn by a human designer, calm and precise, subtly tapered rounded endings. Saturated sky-blue carries most of the symbol, blending smoothly through a smaller green and yellow zone into a very small warm coral crest. Continuous blended color, not separate primary-colored blocks. Pure white square canvas, one isolated symbol occupying approximately 58 percent of the square width and height with generous whitespace. No screenshot frame, no gray surround, no outer rounded tile, no border, no multiple icons or presentation sheet. Clear silhouette at 32 pixels. No letters including G/A/M, no obvious arrow, no wings or feathers, no phones/monitors, no UI outlines, no puzzle pieces, no orbit ring, infinity/Klein/Mobius loop, no sharp folds, no glass/chrome, no 3D render or cast shadow, no watermark. Keep the emotional tone and simplicity of the supplied reference while giving this product its own recognizable abstract shape. DIRECTION A: A SINGLE asymmetric lifted arch, like a soft gravity field gently raising a surface. Its left leg grows from a broad low blue rounded foot and rises into a modest warm-colored crest; its right side tapers into a shorter softly lifted blue tip. Use a smooth concave hollow under the arch, no crossbar and no pointed apex. Poised off-center lift, spacious interior. Shape should feel more like an abstract floating wave than a letter.
